messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — elevated 5xx rate for model-serving/redwood-v3-canary (us-west-2). Error rate jumped from 7% -> 41% over 2m. Linking logs: <https://infra/redwood/alerts/2798765301>

oncall-ml: I'm on it, grabbing logs. Any deploys in the last 20m?

deploy-bot: Deploy started by eng-ml-simone at 2798765260 — rollout: redwood-v3 -> canary group (10% traffic).

eng-ml-simone: That deploy included a weightset refresh + tokenizer remap to fix byte-level offsets. I ran local checks but not a full canary assert.

ops-oliver: Seeing lots of these in the node logs: `ERROR: tokenizer: vocab lookup failed at idx 1023` and `ValueError: embedding shape mismatch: expected (4096,) got (3200,)`

oncall-ml: Paste the relevant excerpt pls

ops-oliver: ```
2026-03-10T15:08:12Z node-7 serve[pid=23] ERROR tokenizer: vocab lookup failed at idx 1023
2026-03-10T15:08:12Z node-7 serve[pid=23] ERROR infer: KV cache dim mismatch, weight dim 4096 != input 3200
2026-03-10T15:08:13Z node-8 serve[pid=12] WARN model: fallback to stable model triggered
```

customer-support-lee: CS has 2 customers reporting gibberish tokens and truncated replies in the last 10m. One flagged as high-impact (finance pipeline).

product-anna: Do we have a quick rollback or kill-switch? We should stop canary ASAP if it's misbehaving.

oncall-ml: I'm flipping the canary feature flag now — routing back to stable while we investigate. Command: 

```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDFLAG_TOKEN' \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle?flag=canary-rollout&state=off
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag toggled by oncall-ml at 2798765330 :white_check_mark: — canary traffic drained, routing to redwood-v3-stable.

eng-ml-simone: Quick update: weightset hash mismatch on deployed bundle. Expected sha256:abc123def.. but nodes pulled sha256:fedcba987.. Looks like the quantized weights pipeline applied an older quant profile that doesn't match the new tokenizer indices.

eng-runtime-maya: Confirmed at runtime: KV cache dims assume token vocab size 50256 but weight embeddings align to vocab size 49920. Translation table drift. Inference fails when token index >= 49920.

oncall-ml: Initiating rollback of the canary rollout to stable tag. Running: 

```bash
redwoodctl rollout rollback --model redwood-v3 --to-tag stable-20260309 --force --wait
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 2798765345. Rolling back canary nodes; expected completion ~30s/node. Monitoring logs/metrics.

oncall-ml: @customer-support-lee please notify affected customers: short note that we observed degraded outputs for a small subset of canary traffic and have reverted to stable. Mention we'll follow up with postmortem.

customer-support-lee: Sent banner and emails to affected customers (IDs: cust-842, cust-777). CS thread opened.

eng-ml-simone: Root cause snapshot: during the tokenizer change I rebuilt vocab with a byte-level tokenizer that collapsed some tokens, shifting indices. The new weight build step expected that new index mapping but the published weight bundle still references the previous index layout due to a stale artifact in the weights registry. Two independent artifacts got out of sync (tokenizer mapping + weight bundle).

eng-ml-simone: Patch planned: rebuild tokenizer with `--preserve-index` and re-run the weight conversion with the matching quantization profile. I'll hold off on redeploy until we add a pre-deploy assert that validates: token-vocab hash == weight.token-map-hash.

product-anna: What's the customer impact window and data-sensitivity risk?

oncall-ml: Impact window approx 8 minutes (2798765320 -> 2798765388). Output corruption only (truncated/gibberish), no evidence of PII leakage or exfil. Low security risk, medium availability impact for those sessions.

eng-sre-jamie: Adding this to the incidents tracker and assigning postmortem to eng-ml-simone. Action items: (1) artifact hash checks in CI, (2) pre-deploy tokenizer/weights compatibility gate, (3) add canary traffic size guard for tokenizer-adjacent deploys.

oncall-ml: Final: stable traffic restored, metrics returning to baseline. Closing pager after one more observation window.

incident-bot: Pager closed by oncall-ml at 2798765399 :white_check_mark: 

oncall-ml: I'll run a short validation harness (1000 synthetic prompts across edge token cases) before we reintroduce the new bundle. Will post when ready. :thumbsup:
